deploy-container.command: docker buildx build --platform linux/amd64,linux/arm64 -f apps/ui/waiting-games/Dockerfile -t iamharryliu/waiting-games:latest -t iamharryliu/waiting-games:${COMMIT_SHA:-latest} --push dist/waiting-games

ensure-cf-project.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw staging-waiting-games || npx wrangler pages project create staging-waiting-games --production-branch main

deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/waiting-games --project-name staging-waiting-games --branch main

manual-deploy.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/waiting-games --project-name staging-waiting-games --branch main

ensure-cf-project:production.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw production-waiting-games || npx wrangler pages project create production-waiting-games --production-branch production

deploy:production.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/waiting-games --project-name production-waiting-games --branch production

ensure-cf-project:preview.command: npx wrangler pages project list 2>&1 | grep -qw preview-waiting-games || npx wrangler pages project create preview-waiting-games --production-branch main

deploy:preview.command: npx wrangler pages deploy dist/waiting-games --project-name preview-waiting-games --branch "$PREVIEW_BRANCH" --commit-hash "${PREVIEW_COMMIT:-$(git rev-parse HEAD)}"
